scenario_name: Agent loses track of card replace after fraud investigation and card upgrade tangent
judge_summary: This assistant handled a sensitive lost-card and fraud scenario effectively, promptly locking the card, filing fraud reports with clear IDs, and completing the replacement order while also giving tailored rewards advice. It responded well to user corrections and maintained context, only briefly re-confirming a choice the user had just given. Overall, the conversation was accurate, coherent, and easy to follow.
